matrix.best_available_evidence: EVD-01 (Candidate External Route Only, Content Unverified) / EVD-05 (Switchgear HIL Test Bench Data)
matrix.candidate_acquisition_route: EVD-01 is a candidate external route; actual operating-state variables and ground truth remain unverified until the underlying data are obtained and inspected.
matrix.smallest_unblock_package: 10 ms digital SCADA event log recording generator breaker 52a/52b auxiliary contact state transitions during uncommanded engine trips.
matrix.primary_blocker: Lack of high-speed digital trip timestamps and HIL hardware interface in POLARIS workspace repository; EVD-01 raw SCADA time-series content is unverified.

matrix.best_available_evidence: EVD-02 (Candidate Dataset Files Absent from Public Portal)
matrix.candidate_acquisition_route: Public HTTP dataset download from NREL OpenEI / OEDI data repository.
matrix.smallest_unblock_package: 1 Hz 3-phase AC active power time-series log during full step-load acceptance (0 -> 100 kW) and derating transients.
matrix.primary_blocker: Empirical acquisition attempt established that raw time-series CSV data files for EVD-02 are absent from NREL OpenEI/OEDI public portal (workspace_copy = false). Class 1.2 remains EXECUTABLE_AFTER_DATA_ACQUISITION pending identification of a valid dataset.

matrix.best_available_evidence: EVD-03 (Caterpillar Industrial Engine Thermal Chamber Cold-Start Dataset)
matrix.candidate_acquisition_route: OEM technical data sharing request / NDA collaboration with Caterpillar Power Systems or field intake differential pressure logging at station.
matrix.smallest_unblock_package: Intake air manifold differential pressure and ambient thermal derate logs under polar blowing snow intake restriction conditions.
matrix.primary_blocker: OEM technical derating dataset requires formal OEM request/partnership (REQUIRES_PARTNERSHIP).

matrix.best_available_evidence: EVD-01 (Antarctic Station Day-Tank SCADA Logs - Candidate Route Only, Content Unverified)
matrix.candidate_acquisition_route: Polar station engineering data request or field instrumentation logging of hydrostatic level sensor at day-tank.
matrix.smallest_unblock_package: 1 Hz day-tank hydrostatic level sensor log during active fuel burn (25 L/h) and simulated fuel line leak event (5%/min).
matrix.primary_blocker: Level dataset identified externally as candidate route, but access request is pending and raw content is unverified (workspace_copy = false). Experiment state explicitly means experiment could become executable after acquisition AND verification of required variables/ground truth.

matrix.best_available_evidence: None (EVD-02 verified to lack fuel flow channels)
matrix.candidate_acquisition_route: Instrument supply/return fuel lines on test loop with dual Coriolis mass flowmeters or request Arctic station fuel skid logs.
matrix.smallest_unblock_package: 1 Hz dual Coriolis mass flowmeter supply and return line mass flow logs under varying generator operating loads.
matrix.primary_blocker: Public microgrid datasets monitor AC bus electrical quantities only. No suitable publicly accessible dual-Coriolis generator fuel-flow dataset was identified during the defined search.

matrix.best_available_evidence: EVD-03 (Caterpillar Industrial Engine Thermal Chamber Cold-Start Dataset)
matrix.candidate_acquisition_route: Controlled block heater power interruption test at station or OEM thermal chamber cold-soak dataset request.
matrix.smallest_unblock_package: Multi-point engine block temperature thermocouple decay log following block heater power loss at T_ambient < -30°C.
matrix.primary_blocker: Requires controlled field heater power interruption trial or OEM thermal chamber dataset (REQUIRES_PARTNERSHIP).

matrix.best_available_evidence: Separate Future HIL/Lab Generator ECU Test Harness (EVD-04 provides J1939 protocol/parser research reference ONLY)
matrix.candidate_acquisition_route: Connect CAN logger directly to stationary diesel generator ECU with forced fault injection harness on lab bench.
matrix.smallest_unblock_package: Raw CAN-bus J1939 diagnostic trouble code (DTC) sniffer log captured at stationary generator ECU connector during forced fault injection.
matrix.primary_blocker: EVD-04 provides heavy-vehicle J1939 CAN traffic for protocol/parser research only, NOT stationary generator fault telemetry. Class 1.7 experimental enablement requires a separate future HIL/lab generator ECU test harness.

matrix.best_available_evidence: EVD-05 (High-Speed Switchgear Auxiliary Contact Bounce & LOTO Interlock Logging Trial Data)
matrix.candidate_acquisition_route: Research collaboration / testing agreement with university power systems high-voltage laboratory.
matrix.smallest_unblock_package: Digital logic analyzer log (1 ms sampling) recording LOTO key switch auxiliary contact transition and contact bounce.
matrix.primary_blocker: Requires switchgear test bench instrumentation or HIL contact loop logger (REQUIRES_PARTNERSHIP).
